extracted.intended_audience: experienced digital/video producers seeking a producer role at The Daily Wire (YouTube/social-first production)
extracted.subtask_description: Hiring/job-posting rubric for a Producer responsible for end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of original video, audio, and digital content for a news/entertainment publisher, with emphasis on YouTube and social platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-to-end production responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: End-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of original video, audio, and digital content that reflects the company's brand standards and editorial values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leads projects from greenlight to final delivery—scoping work, building schedules and budgets, coordinating talent and crews, guiding creative execution, mitigating risks, and ensuring all deliverables meet quality, timeline, and cost goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reflects brand standards and editorial values
rubrics_metrics.description: Content must reflect the company's brand standards and editorial values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Producer is expected to create material consistent with editorial direction and brand voice; work includes tailoring messaging appropriately for the publisher's audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scoping projects and defining success metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines project scope, goals, deliverables, and success metrics, leading kickoffs and stand-ups to align cross-functional teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes what 'done' looks like and runs project-level meetings to align stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintaining authoritative documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintains source-of-truth documentation (briefs, production plans, RACI) and builds detailed production calendars and run-of-show plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keeps centralized documents for responsibilities, schedules, and show structure to ensure clarity across teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule and milestone tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Tracks milestones, interdependencies, and approvals to drive on-time delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipates risks, removes blockers, and prioritizes tasks as needs arise to keep projects on schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budgeting and cost management
rubrics_metrics.description: Builds budgets and ensures deliverables meet cost goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scopes work with budget awareness and manages expenditures relative to project objectives (implied in lead-from-greenlight responsibilities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Talent collaboration and performance coaching
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborates with on-camera talent to shape shows, elevate performance, and extend their voice across platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a creative leader and trusted partner to hosts; helps shape segments, guide delivery, and tailor material for talent strengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative execution and format development
rubrics_metrics.description: Writes and produces segments, treatments, and formats for YouTube-first audiences, guiding visual and narrative approach for maximum impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comfort with building formats and writing daily segments; steers both creative vision and production execution to optimize for platform and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital-first / platform expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Fluency in digital-first production and expertise with YouTube and social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experience optimizing content format, packaging, and distribution for YouTube, social platforms, podcast, and OTT is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytics-driven strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitors analytics, trends, and audience feedback to refine creative strategy and boost reach and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses data and audience signals to iterate on content, formats, and promotional tactics to increase engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-functional stakeholder communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Serves as primary creative and production partner for executives, hosts, and contributors, clearly communicating expectations and deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acts as liaison between creative, production, and leadership; sets and enforces timelines and deliverable expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vendor and resource management
rubrics_metrics.description: Sources and manages vendors, studios, gear, freelancers, and post-production resources; handles travel, permits, and asset tracking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manages third-party relationships and logistical details required to execute shoots and post workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Day-of execution and troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: Leads day-of execution in studio and field, troubleshooting in real time while upholding safety and quality standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responsible for on-set decisions, problem-solving, and ensuring shoots run smoothly and safely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-production pipeline oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: Oversees post-production pipeline, managing review cadence, QC, versioning, captions/metadata, and archiving.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures quality control, proper metadata/captions, version management, and archival practices for deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform-specific packaging and delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Tailors final content for YouTube, social media, podcast, and OTT platforms, optimizing packaging and delivery for each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adapts length, formatting, metadata, and other distribution elements to the needs and best practices of each target platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong production management experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Strong production management across pre-production, scheduling, budgeting, and on-set/studio coordination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrable background managing the end-to-end production process, from planning through execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear and professional communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear and professional communicator, both written and verbal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Able to produce professional briefs, communicate with talent and stakeholders, and write segments or instructions clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team-first collaborative approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Team-first, collaborative approach to projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works well within cross-functional teams and supports collective goals over personal preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial judgment and story sense
rubrics_metrics.description: Sharp editorial judgment and story sense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to identify compelling narratives, shape stories for impact, and make editorial decisions that serve the audience and brand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience specificity (conservative-leaning)
rubrics_metrics.description: Understands conservative-leaning audiences and tailors messaging appropriately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experience or sensitivity to the publisher's target audience and the ability to craft messaging that resonates with that demographic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attention to detail and accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Meticulous attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy, fact-checking, and responsible presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures factual correctness and responsible presentation of information across produced content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool proficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Proficient with production and collaboration tools (script formatting, project management platforms, basic editing tools).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comfortable using industry-standard tools for scripting, scheduling, project tracking, and entry-level editing tasks.
